meta.title: Open-Prism LaTeX preview
meta.description: Renders .tex files as compiled documents in the right sidebar preview. Open a .tex file from chat, Files, or a delivered file card and the pane compiles it with the local TeX Live, shows the pages with fit-width and zoom controls, and offers the PDF for download. Compiling happens on this machine with shell escape disabled; it needs pdflatex (or xelatex, lualatex, latexmk) from TeX Live and Ghostscript (gs). Plain text stays available from the preview's renderer menu.
